# White Space Designs

> Pretoria-based AI automation and web design agency. We build AI agents that answer enquiries, follow up and book appointments for small businesses, plus the websites that bring customers in. Founded by Jason Russell. Serving Pretoria, Centurion, Midrand and Pretoria East, plus select clients elsewhere in South Africa.

Website: https://whitespacedesigns.co.za/
Contact: studio@whitespacedesigns.co.za
Book a free discovery call: https://cal.com/whitespacedesigns/discovery-call

## Quick facts

- Business: White Space Designs, an AI automation and web design agency based in Pretoria, South Africa.
- Founder: Jason Russell.
- What it does: builds AI agents and automation that answer enquiries, follow up and book appointments for small businesses, plus websites.
- Pricing (ZAR, South African clients): AI automation build R9,500 once-off; web design from R7,500; care plans from R1,500 per month. AI running costs are separate and disclosed up front.
- Typical timeline: about two weeks from discovery call to live.
- Service area: Pretoria, Centurion, Midrand and Pretoria East; remote-first, select clients elsewhere in South Africa and internationally.
- Start: free 30-minute discovery call, no obligation.

## Services

- [AI Automation & AI Agents](https://whitespacedesigns.co.za/services/ai-automation/): custom AI agents, WhatsApp bots, lead qualification and marketing automation. Once-off build fee of R9,500.
- [Web Design](https://whitespacedesigns.co.za/services/web-design/): custom, mobile-first websites built to convert. From R7,500.
- [Care Plans & Retainers](https://whitespacedesigns.co.za/services/retainers/): ongoing website maintenance, AI agent support and monthly automation. From R1,500 per month.
- [Brand Identity](https://whitespacedesigns.co.za/services/brand-identity/): logo, colour, typography and brand guidelines.
- [Full-Stack Development](https://whitespacedesigns.co.za/services/full-stack-development/): custom web apps, back-end logic and API integrations.
